pool: --lines-tier graded: the 67 LAB-tier Fe I lines AT OR BELOW the 0.6 depth gate, of 176 in band. NOT --lines-deep-graded, which is the saturated population above the gate (RYA-984/RYA-954).

invocations.<3D> pair: scripts/derive_band_products.py --star solar --element Fe --ion I --lo 4200 --hi 6910 --force-synthesis --instrument kpno_solar_atlas --holding solar_kpno_molecfit_corrected --lines-tier graded --engine-b-deck gerber-mean3d   (and --engine-b-deck gerber-mean3d-lte)
invocations.1D pair: scripts/derive_band_products.py --star solar --element Fe --ion I --lo 4200 --hi 6910 --force-synthesis --instrument kpno_solar_atlas --holding solar_kpno_molecfit_corrected --lines-tier graded --engine-b-deck gerber-nlte     (and --engine-b-deck gerber-1d-lte)

differencing_rule: PER-LINE PAIRED, then aggregate. Never the difference of the published product values (RYA-1040 median collision), and never across two atmospheres (RYA-542).

nlte_on_mean3D.meaning: <3D>-NLTE minus <3D>-LTE on ONE atmosphere: the NLTE effect

nlte_on_1D.meaning: ENGINE-B-NLTE minus synth-1D-LTE-gerber on ONE atmosphere (MARCS.GES)

increment_mean3D_minus_1D.meaning: how much the <3D> deck ADDS over the 1D deck, per line. RYA-1045: this is the quantity that agrees with Amarsi and exonerates the <3D> deck.
